command: python -m flight_simulator takeoff_live takeoff --brain connectome --backend flightgear --telemetry-port 5501 --control-port 5502 --period 1.0

control.label: FLY BRAIN (connectome) flying the takeoff
control.neurons_decide: pitch (jump/rotation, flare), steering and roll through descending-neuron rates (DNp01/02/04/11, DNp07, DNp15, DNa02, DNp20, MN9)
control.code_decides: synthetic runway/path and known-obstacle sensory encoding of aircraft state, the fixed decoder from DN rates to controls, the behavioural-state gate (standing/flying), a fixed-gain pitch-rate reflex (haltere stand-in), and phase handover (flies.py); takeoff_live holds the parking brake while the brain calibrates and releases it at the handover
control.autopilot: never: the fly does not use the airplane autopilot/autothrottle; AutopilotGuard forces it off and stops the run if it cannot
